title: Restricted Fourier weight observation from full inputs
statement: Let $n\in\mathbb N$, let $f$ be a Boolean function on $n$ coordinates, let $J$ be a finite set of those coordinates, and let $S\subseteq J$. Given three full sign vectors $z,y,y'\in\{\pm1\}^n$, split each into its coordinates in $J$ and outside $J$. The restricted Fourier weight observation from these inputs is the restricted Fourier weight observation for $f$, $J$, and $S$, evaluated using the outside-$J$ part of $z$ and the inside-$J$ parts of $y$ and $y'$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean function on $n$ coordinates
$J$ is a finite subset of the $n$ coordinates
$z,y,y'$ are full sign vectors on the $n$ coordinates
caveat: The underlying restricted Fourier weight observation and the coordinate-splitting map are not defined in the payload.
